sections.content: You know *ya* and *todavía no* from Unit 2. Use *ya* in questions to ask whether something has happened already; a short negative answer is *No, todavía no*. The *pretérito perfecto* stays the same.

items.english: Have you already seen the river?

items.spanish: Sí, ya he visto el río.
items.english: Yes, I have already seen the river.
Have they already bought the tickets?

sections.content: *Ya* usually comes before the auxiliary: *¿Ya has visto el río?* Putting it after the participle (*¿Has visto ya el río?*) is also possible, but practise the order with *ya* first.
